messages.text: Lunch poll: I'm sick of the cafeteria salad bar. Anyone have a good spot within a 10 min walk? Need something that isn't a 40 minute wait.
The Vietnamese place on the corner past the dry cleaner. Banh mi is $11 and they're fast. Line moves.
Seconding anything with a fast line. Also the halal cart by the subway entrance, chicken over rice, can't beat it.
Banh mi sounds good. Do they take orders ahead online? Last time I stood there for 15 min just to order.
Yeah, they have an app. Order from your desk and walk over, it's usually ready when you get there.
Unrelated but is the ramen spot on the next block still open? I walked by Friday and the lights were off.
Closed for renovation I think. Sign said back in October. Bummer, their spicy miso was elite.
Yep, I saw the same sign. There's a new poke place opening in that space after, supposedly.
Poke is fine but I need something warm. Fall is basically here.
Update: went with the halal cart. Chicken over rice with extra white sauce. No regrets, but I'm going to need a nap at 2.
Classic. White sauce is the real reason people go back.
Told you. Did you get the hot sauce too? Be careful, it's no joke.
Got a little. My forehead disagrees with that decision.
Anyone want to do a team lunch Thursday? Thinking the Italian place with the lunch special, panini plus soup for $14.
I'm in. Can we go at 12:30 though? I've got payment batch checks until noon.
In as well. 12:30 works for me, I'll bring the poke place idea for dessert chat.
12:30 it is. I'll grab a table for three, the place gets packed after 12:45.
